title: docs(polli-cli): note that prices only apply to public models
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
Follow-up to #13386.

The image-model example documents `--completion-image-price 0.01` on a `create` that defaults to `--visibility private`. On that path `community-endpoints.ts` replaces every price with `communityEndpointPrices({})` — all zeros — so anyone copying the example gets a silently free model.

- Adds one line stating prices only apply to public models, and that making a published model private clears them again.

gist.headline: Prices need daylight
gist.blurb: A small note now keeps model prices from wandering into the private garden, where they politely become zero. Copy-paste economics, clarified.
gist.summary: Updated the polli-cli image-model creation example to state that --completion-image-price 0.01 applies only to public models, while private visibility resets published-model prices to zero.
gist.impact: Developers configuring image models can now see that pricing requires public visibility and avoid expecting private models to retain completion prices.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli as a careful garden keeper with a tiny accountant visor, placing a price-tag flower into a sunny public-model garden while a shaded private pot has a clear zero-price label; code-plants and a small CLI terminal establish the developer context.
